import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int v;

        ModInt(long val) {
            val %= MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            v = (int) val;
        }

        ModInt() {
            this(0);
        }

        static int mod_inverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;
                x -= q * y;
                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        static int mod_inverse(int a) {
            return mod_inverse(a, MOD);
        }

        public int intValue() {
            return v;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt o) {
            v += o.v;
            if (v >= MOD) v -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt subtract(ModInt o) {
            v -= o.v;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        static long fast_mod(long x) {
            return x % MOD;
        }

        ModInt multiply(ModInt o) {
            v = (int) fast_mod((long) v * o.v);
            return this;
        }

        ModInt divide(ModInt o) {
            return multiply(o.mod_inverse());
        }

        ModInt addAndReturnNew(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.v).add(b);
        }

        ModInt subtractAndReturnNew(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.v).subtract(b);
        }

        ModInt multiplyAndReturnNew(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.v).multiply(b);
        }

        ModInt divideAndReturnNew(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
            return new ModInt(a.v).divide(b);
        }

        ModInt increment() {
            v = (v == MOD - 1) ? 0 : v + 1;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt decrement() {
            v = (v == 0) ? MOD - 1 : v - 1;
            return this;
        }

        ModInt incrementPost() {
            ModInt tmp = new ModInt(v);
            increment();
            return tmp;
        }

        ModInt decrementPost() {
            ModInt tmp = new ModInt(v);
            decrement();
            return tmp;
        }

        ModInt negate() {
            return v != 0 ? new ModInt(MOD - v) : new ModInt(0);
        }

        boolean equals(ModInt o) {
            return v == o.v;
        }

        boolean notEquals(ModInt o) {
            return v != o.v;
        }

        ModInt mod_inverse() {
            return new ModInt(mod_inverse(v));
        }

        ModInt pow(long e) {
            if (e < 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exponent must be non-negative");
            }
            ModInt b = new ModInt(v);
            ModInt res = new ModInt(1);
            while (e > 0) {
                if ((e & 1) == 1) {
                    res.multiply(b);
                }
                b.multiply(b);
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static final int MAX_N = 7;
    static int N;
    static ModInt[][] prob = new ModInt[MAX_N][MAX_N];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masks_by_pop = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_N; ++i) {
            masks_by_pop.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] pos_map = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(pos_map, -1);

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
            int pop = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            pos_map[mask] = masks_by_pop.get(pop).size();
            masks_by_pop.get(pop).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> dp = new HashMap<>();
        dp.put(1L << pos_map[0], new ModInt(1));

        for (int iter = 0; iter < N; ++iter) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> ndp = new HashMap<>();

            for (int cur = 0; cur < (1 << N); ++cur) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                    if (((cur >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod.multiply(prob[iter][j]);
                    } else {
                        ModInt one = new ModInt(1);
                        ModInt probVal = prob[iter][j];
                        ModInt diff = new ModInt(one.v - probVal.v);
                        if (diff.v < 0) diff.v += MOD;
                        prod.multiply(diff);
                    }
                }

                for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : dp.entrySet()) {
                    long cur_state = entry.getKey();
                    ModInt cur_p = entry.getValue();

                    long next_state = 0;

                    for (int mask : masks_by_pop.get(iter)) {
                        if (((cur_state >> pos_map[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                            for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                                if ((((cur >> i) & 1) == 1) && (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0)) {
                                    next_state |= 1L << pos_map[mask | (1 << i)];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    ModInt product = new ModInt(cur_p.v).multiply(new ModInt(prod.v));
                    ndp.put(next_state, addModInt(ndp.getOrDefault(next_state, new ModInt(0)), product));
                }
            }

            dp = ndp;
        }

        ModInt ans = new ModInt(0);
        long full = (1L << N) - 1;

        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : dp.entrySet()) {
            if (((entry.getKey() >> pos_map[(int) full]) & 1) == 1) {
                ans = addModInt(ans, entry.getValue());
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans.intValue());
    }

    static ModInt addModInt(ModInt a, ModInt b) {
        ModInt res = new ModInt(a.v);
        res.add(b);
        return res;
    }
}
